Compare companies

Up to four companies side by side. Values marked ↗ link to their source; open a company for the full evidence. Amounts in the table are shortened (hover for the full figure; the CSV and the phone layout show full figures). ▲ marks the highest revenue and result among the companies compared, each on the basis shown (group accounts where a company files them; not ranked across currencies).

How to read and verify these profiles

Find. Search by company name, organisation number, municipality, industry, registered activity or a role holder's name. The tiles at the top and the filters narrow the list; sort by revenue, growth, employees or latest news.

Compare. Tick the box next to up to four companies (or use “Add to compare” on a profile), then press Compare. The comparison can be downloaded as CSV or shared as a link.

Verify. Summary sentences carry numbered sources (statements about what is missing name the source that was checked where there is one). Values in a profile link to the page they were read from; under “Evidence” each published claim shows the exact quoted text (span), when the page was fetched and the SHA-256 of the fetched content, so it can be checked against the live page.

Sources. Brønnøysund Register Centre (Enhetsregisteret entity, roles and sub-unit records; Regnskapsregisteret annual accounts), NAV's public vacancy register, and each company's own website. A website is shown only when it is proven to belong to this exact legal entity, and social profiles, news and careers pages come only from such a verified site. A LinkedIn or Facebook link is shown because the company's own site links to it; those platforms, review sites and the press are not read.

Missing is not zero. “Not available” means a source was checked and had no value; “failed” or “blocked” means the source could not be read in this run. Neither is ever shown as zero.
